tickets.title: JSONB Containment query (@>)
tickets.description: Filters transaction logs containing a nested state `status: "flagged"` inside the JSONB payload.
tasks: Filters transaction logs containing a nested state `status: "flagged"` inside the JSONB payload.
learning_objectives: Understand semi-structured data querying using JSONB.
tickets.evaluation: `compare_result_set(actual, expected)` `check_command_used("@>")` `check_command_used("->>")` **[A] Correctness (40 pts)**: 40 pts for exact filtered entries. **[B] Optimality (30 pts)**: 30 pts if query utilizes a GIN index on `payload`. **[C] Quality (20 pts)**: 20 pts for proper key extraction path formats.
common_mistakes: Confusing the -> operator (returns JSON) with ->> (returns text).
hints: PostgreSQL has robust JSONB operators like -> and ->>.
Check the Postgres documentation for JSON function syntax.

solution.query.sql:
SELECT
      id,
      event_type,
      payload->>'user' AS user_involved,
      payload->'meta'->>'gateway' AS gateway_name
    FROM audit_logs
    WHERE payload @> '{"status": "flagged"}';

tickets.title: Extracting Nested Field Paths
tickets.description: Extracts nested routing fields using postgres jsonb path selectors.
tasks: Extracts nested routing fields using postgres jsonb path selectors.
learning_objectives: Understand semi-structured data querying using JSONB.
tickets.evaluation: `compare_result_set(actual, expected)` `check_command_used("#>>")` **[A] Correctness (40 pts)**: 40 pts for extracting correct gateway keys. **[B] Optimality (30 pts)**: 30 pts for casting parsing. **[C] Quality (20 pts)**: 20 pts for casting JSON string output explicitly to `numeric`.
common_mistakes: Confusing the -> operator (returns JSON) with ->> (returns text).
hints: PostgreSQL has robust JSONB operators like -> and ->>.
Check the Postgres documentation for JSON function syntax.

solution.query.sql:
SELECT
      id,
      payload#>>'{meta, gateway}' AS gateway_used,
      (payload->>'amount')::numeric AS transaction_amount
    FROM audit_logs
    WHERE event_type = 'transfer';
